overview_description.description:
HappyDay Delivery

Delivery company with big ambitious to connect all UAE businesses with 25 years of experience in logistics and express delivery. Our services starting from express transport services, parcel and goods delivery, food and sweet delivery, to receiving goods from merchants and delivering them to customers. 

Our mission is to provide the best services at the best prices,
and this is achieved through your evaluation of the service and your satisfaction with it.

Sit at Home/work
We Will Take Care
Delivery The complete safety of the parcels, goods or gifts that we transport while preserving them from scratching, breaking or damage. In the event of damage to the order from a company, the company bears the value of the goods.


Happyday Delivery is a company that specializes in courier services. we partner with small businesses and online stores and help them reach their customers. Not only that, but Happyday Delivery can also buy bespoke products from your selected store and have it delivered.

The company offers its services in the 7 leading cities of UAE. So if you are based out anywhere in consists of seven independent city-states: Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Umm al-Qaiwain, Fujairah, Ajman and Ra’s al-Khaimah, you can avail the services of Happyday Delivery.

For businesses, Happyday Delivery comes with only one subscription plans available at same price for all emirates. Apart from that, we let you choose your own customized plan at your convenience. Moreover, growing their business rapidly, Happyday Delivery can ensure delivery time as fast as possible.

For individual consumers, we offer their service at a very cost-effective price. You can get your package delivered at same price. You can avail Happyday Delivery service from their smartphone app and through the website.

Same Day Courier Services With Ease
At Happyday Delivery App, our innovative delivery platform provides business owners with an integrated, flexible, and seamless way of managing deliveries. With the ability to book or schedule same day courier services, fulfilling your daily delivery requirements couldn’t be easier!
